summary: Iteration 104 — Full retest of the parent medical-certificate save bug (18/08/2026 fix). BOTH backend and UI verified end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_parent_certificate_flow.py: 4/4 PASS (login as armida.raschi@gmail.com/Test1234, GET /athletes/6a5ec7347c201d9cb7eb70d2, POST /certificates/simple with issue=2026-01-07 expiry=2027-01-06 → GET returns persisted cert with correct dates and validity_months=12 derived; athlete doc has medical_certificate_expiry/issue_date synced; second POST updating only issue_date to 2026-02-10 also persists). UI E2E via Playwright: (1) 'Inserisci dati certificato' opens the form; entering 07/01/2026 + 12 months auto-shows 'Scadenza 06/01/2027'; clicking 'Salva' triggers the 'Certificato salvato!' alert; the card immediately switches to 'Scadenza: 06/01/2027 / Emissione: 07/01/2026' (NO more 'Nessun certificato inserito'). (2) After a full page reload the certificate STILL shows correctly (persistence OK). (3) 'Modifica date certificato' now opens with BOTH fields pre-populated: Data Emissione='07/01/2026', Mesi di Validità='12' (the previous bug where validity was empty and Salva was disabled is FIXED). (4) Changing ONLY issue date to 15/03/2026 recomputes expiry to 14/03/2027 and Salva persists it. The keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' fix on the ScrollView was verified indirectly (Salva was reachable without keyboard dismissal issue). SIDE-NOTE (not blocking): none of the data-testid attributes (`insert-certificate-dates-btn`, `modify-certificate-dates-btn`, `cert-issue-date-input`, `cert-validity-months-input`, `cert-save-btn`) are rendered to the DOM — `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]')` returns []. Reason: the source uses `data-testid` as a raw prop on RN TouchableOpacity/TextInput but React Native Web ONLY forwards the `testID` prop (which it then maps to data-testid). All flows work via text/placeholder selectors, so this is a TEST INSTRUMENTATION issue, not a user-facing bug — but the review request explicitly asks to test using those data-testids, so it will bite future automated tests. Recommend main agent rename `data-testid` → `testID` on the 5 elements in /app/frontend/app/parent/athlete/[id].tsx CertificateDateForm (lines 131, 147, 171, 184, 207). Bug fix as a whole = CONFIRMED WORKING.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses `data-testid` as a raw prop on TouchableOpacity and TextInput at lines 131, 147, 171, 184, 207. React Native Web only forwards the `testID` prop (mapped to data-testid on the DOM). Result: `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]')` returns [] on the parent athlete page and the testIDs given in the review request cannot be resolved by Playwright. Fix: rename all 5 occurrences from `data-testid="..."` to `testID="..."`.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/parent/athlete/[id].tsx: CertificateDateForm useEffect at lines 56-70 correctly re-syncs issueDate/validityMonths when the async-loaded `certificate` prop arrives, and guards with `if (showForm) return;` so it does not clobber user input. Good.

handleSave at lines 97-122 posts to /certificates/simple and shows platform-appropriate alert (window.alert on web, Alert.alert on native). Good, but consider using api.post response for optimistic UI update instead of only calling onSaved().

Consistency issue across the file: some elements use React Native's `testID` prop while CertificateDateForm mixes in `data-testid`. Standardize on `testID` — RN Web will emit the correct DOM attribute automatically.
